Still, it is possible that <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha=\delta" display="inline"><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>δ</mi></mrow></math> or <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta=\gamma" display="inline"><mrow><mi>β</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow></math>. If <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha=\delta" display="inline"><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>δ</mi></mrow></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta=\gamma" display="inline"><mrow><mi>β</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow></math> then by Proposition <a href="#Thmtheorem6" title="Proposition 6. ‣ Proof. ‣ 2 Some terminology and tools ‣ The Maximum Number of Digons Formed by Pairwise Intersecting Pseudocircles" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">6</span></a> the edges do not cross.
Otherwise, we add a new pseudocircle as a substitute in the following way.
Suppose without loss of generality that <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta=\gamma" display="inline"><mrow><mi>β</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow></math> (if <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m14" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha=\delta" display="inline"><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>δ</mi></mrow></math> we switch the labels <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m15" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha" display="inline"><mi>α</mi></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m16" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\gamma" display="inline"><mi>γ</mi></math> and the labels <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m17" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta" display="inline"><mi>β</mi></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m18" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta" display="inline"><mi>δ</mi></math>).
Then we add a new pseudocircle <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m19" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\gamma^{\prime}" display="inline"><msup><mi>γ</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></math> that goes very close to <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m20" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta=\gamma" display="inline"><mrow><mi>β</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow></math>
outside of the digon-region of <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m21" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta=\gamma" display="inline"><mrow><mi>β</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow></math> except for near the vertices of the digon formed by
<math id="S3.SS3.p2.m22" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta=\gamma" display="inline"><mrow><mi>β</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m23" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta" display="inline"><mi>δ</mi></math>. There, the pseudocircle <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m24" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\gamma^{\prime}" display="inline"><msup><mi>γ</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></math> goes into the digon-region of <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m25" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta=\gamma" display="inline"><mrow><mi>β</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow></math>
thus destroying the digon formed by <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m26" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta=\gamma" display="inline"><mrow><mi>β</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m27" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta" display="inline"><mi>δ</mi></math> and creating a new digon
with <math id="S3.SS3.p2.m28" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta" display="inline"><mi>δ</mi></math> that is fully contained in the digon that was destroyed.
See Figure <a href="#S3.F7" title="Figure 7 ‣ 3.3 Independent edges cross evenly ‣ 3 Proof of Theorem 2 ‣ The Maximum Number of Digons Formed by Pairwise Intersecting Pseudocircles" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">7</span></a> for an example.</p>
</div>
<figure id="S3.F7" class="ltx_figure"><object type="image/svg+xml" data="distinct.pdf2svg.svg" id="S3.F7.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_landscape" width="314" height="215" style="width: 628px; height: unset; max-width: 100%"></object>
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure"><span class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Figure 7</span>: </span><span class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">If <math id="S3.F7.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> and <math id="S3.F7.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\gamma^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> are edges and <math id="S3.F7.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta=\gamma" display="inline"><mrow><mi>β</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>γ</mi></mrow></math>, then we can replace <math id="S3.F7.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\gamma" display="inline"><mi>γ</mi></math> with <math id="S3.F7.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\gamma^{\prime}" display="inline"><msup><mi>γ</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></math> such that <math id="S3.F7.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> and <math id="S3.F7.m14" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\gamma^{\prime\rm out},\delta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mrow><mo mathsize="1.580em">′</mo><mo lspace="0em">⁣</mo><mi>out</mi></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> maintain the same number of crossings as the original edges. Each pseudocircle’s label is placed within the digon-region associated with that pseudocircle.</span></figcaption>
</figure>
<div id="S3.SS3.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">The edge <math id="S3.SS3.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\gamma^{\prime\rm out},\delta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mrow><mo mathsize="1.420em">′</mo><mo lspace="0em">⁣</mo><mi>out</mi></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> starts at <math id="S3.SS3.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\gamma^{\prime\rm out}" display="inline"><msup><mi>γ</mi><mrow><mo mathsize="1.420em">′</mo><mo lspace="0em">⁣</mo><mi>out</mi></mrow></msup></math> and follows the edge <math id="S3.SS3.p3.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\gamma^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math>, while <math id="S3.SS3.p3.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> passes by <math id="S3.SS3.p3.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\gamma^{\prime\rm in}" display="inline"><msup><mi>γ</mi><mrow><mo mathsize="1.420em">′</mo><mo lspace="0em">⁣</mo><mi>in</mi></mrow></msup></math> according the above rules.
The number of crossings of the two independent edges <math id="S3.SS3.p3.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.p3.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\gamma^{\prime\rm out},\delta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mrow><mo mathsize="1.420em">′</mo><mo lspace="0em">⁣</mo><mi>out</mi></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> is equal to that of the original edges
because <math id="S3.SS3.p3.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\gamma^{\prime\rm out},\delta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mrow><mo mathsize="1.420em">′</mo><mo lspace="0em">⁣</mo><mi>out</mi></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.p3.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\gamma^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> are drawn in precisely the same way
as far as passing from the inside or from the outside of intermediate vertices of <math id="S3.SS3.p3.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="G" display="inline"><mi>G</mi></math>.
Note that the new vertex <math id="S3.SS3.p3.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\gamma^{\prime\rm in}" display="inline"><msup><mi>γ</mi><mrow><mo mathsize="1.420em">′</mo><mo lspace="0em">⁣</mo><mi>in</mi></mrow></msup></math> becomes an intermediate vertex for <math id="S3.SS3.p3.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math>, however, it is not an endpoint of <math id="S3.SS3.p3.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\gamma^{\prime\rm out},\delta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mrow><mo mathsize="1.420em">′</mo><mo lspace="0em">⁣</mo><mi>out</mi></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math>, thus it does not matter whether <math id="S3.SS3.p3.m14" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> passes it from the inside or from the outside.</p>
</div>
<div id="S3.SS3.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">Henceforth we assume that the pseudocircles <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha" display="inline"><mi>α</mi></math>, <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta" display="inline"><mi>β</mi></math>, <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\gamma" display="inline"><mi>γ</mi></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta" display="inline"><mi>δ</mi></math> are distinct.
We proceed by considering the six possible cyclic orders of the vertices <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha^{\rm out}" display="inline"><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup></math>, <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta^{\rm in}" display="inline"><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup></math>, <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\gamma^{\rm out}" display="inline"><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta^{\rm in}" display="inline"><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup></math>.
If the cyclic order is <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in},\gamma^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math>, then <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\gamma^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> do not intersect.
The cyclic orders <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\gamma^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in},\delta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in},\beta^{\rm in},\gamma^{\rm out})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> are symmetric (by switching the labels <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m14" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha" display="inline"><mi>α</mi></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m15" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\gamma" display="inline"><mi>γ</mi></math> and the labels <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m16" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta" display="inline"><mi>β</mi></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m17" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta" display="inline"><mi>δ</mi></math>), and the same goes for the cyclic orders <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m18" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in},\delta^{\rm in},\gamma^{\rm out})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m19" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\gamma^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in},\beta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math>.
Therefore, it is enough to consider the cyclic orders <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m20" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\gamma^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in},\delta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math>, <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m21" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\gamma^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in},\beta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.p4.m22" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in},\gamma^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math>.</p>
</div>
<div id="S3.SS3.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">Recall that we only care about how each edge passes by the vertices of the other edge.
The following proposition summarizes the desired properties.</p>
</div>
<div id="Thmtheorem8" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_prop">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Proposition 8</span></span><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span>
</h6>
<div id="Thmtheorem8.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Assume that the following conditions are satisfied:</span></p>
<ol id="S3.I2" class="ltx_enumerate">
<li id="S3.I2.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(A)</span> 
<div id="S3.I2.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">If </span><math id="S3.I2.i1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha^{\rm out},\gamma^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in}" display="inline"><mrow><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup></mrow></math><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> and </span><math id="S3.I2.i1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta^{\rm in}" display="inline"><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup></math><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, appear in this cyclic order along </span><math id="S3.I2.i1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c" display="inline"><mi>c</mi></math><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, then </span><math id="S3.I2.i1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="d(\gamma^{\rm out},(\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in}))\neq d(\beta^{\rm in},(%
\gamma^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in}))" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≠</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">;</span></p>
</div>
</li>
<li id="S3.I2.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(B)</span> 
<div id="S3.I2.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">if </span><math id="S3.I2.i2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha^{\rm out},\gamma^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in}" display="inline"><mrow><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup></mrow></math><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> and </span><math id="S3.I2.i2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta^{\rm in}" display="inline"><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup></math><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> appear in this cyclic order along </span><math id="S3.I2.i2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c" display="inline"><mi>c</mi></math><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, then </span><math id="S3.I2.i2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="d(\gamma^{\rm out},(\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in}))=d(\delta^{\rm in},(%
\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in}))" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">; and</span></p>
</div>
</li>
<li id="S3.I2.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(C)</span> 
<div id="S3.I2.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">if </span><math id="S3.I2.i3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in},\gamma^{\rm out}" display="inline"><mrow><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup></mrow></math><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> and </span><math id="S3.I2.i3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta^{\rm in}" display="inline"><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup></math><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> appear in this cyclic order along </span><math id="S3.I2.i3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c" display="inline"><mi>c</mi></math><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">, then </span><math id="S3.I2.i3.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="d(\alpha^{\rm out},(\gamma^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in}))\neq d(\delta^{\rm in},(%
\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in}))" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≠</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> and </span><math id="S3.I2.i3.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="d(\gamma^{\rm out},(\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in}))\neq d(\beta^{\rm in},(%
\gamma^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in}))" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≠</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">.</span></p>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
<p class="ltx_p"><span class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Then <math id="Thmtheorem8.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> and <math id="Thmtheorem8.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\gamma^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> cross an even number of times.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<section id="S3.SS3.SSS0.P0.SPx1" class="ltx_subparagraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subparagraph">Proof.</h4>

<div id="S3.SS3.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">From properties (i), (ii) and (iii) it follows that the parity of the number of crossings between <math id="S3.SS3.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\gamma^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in})" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> depends only on the inside/outside decisions at the vertices <math id="S3.SS3.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha^{\rm out},\beta^{\rm in},\gamma^{\rm out}" display="inline"><mrow><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup></mrow></math> and <math id="S3.SS3.SSS0.P0.SPx1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta^{\rm in}" display="inline"><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup></math>. This means that it is enough to check a single drawing for each set of inside/outside decisions that are allowed by the claim.
The proof follows by a case analysis that is easy to verify by inspection,
see Figure <a href="#S3.F8" title="Figure 8 ‣ Proof. ‣ 3.3 Independent edges cross evenly ‣ 3 Proof of Theorem 2 ‣ The Maximum Number of Digons Formed by Pairwise Intersecting Pseudocircles" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">8</span></a> for illustrations of the possible cases.</p>
</div>
<figure id="S3.F8" class="ltx_figure">
<div class="ltx_flex_figure">

<figure id="S3.F8.sf1" class="ltx_figure ltx_figure_panel"><object type="image/svg+xml" data="orderA2.pdf2svg.svg" id="S3.F8.sf1.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_img_landscape" width="261" height="136" style="width: 522px; height: unset; max-width: 100%"></object>

\gamma^{\rm out},\delta^{\rm in}))" display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>α</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≠</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>β</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>γ</mi><mi>out</mi></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>δ</mi><mi>in</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math>.</span></figcaption>
